# Code of Conduct

[繁體中文](/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) | **English** | [日本語](/.github/i18n/CODE_OF_CONDUCT_ja.md) | [한국어](/.github/i18n/CODE_OF_CONDUCT_ko.md)

This project adopts the [Contributor Covenant 3.0](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/3/0/code_of_conduct/) as its code of conduct. The sections below add this project's scope, the things it cares about most, and how to report a problem.

## Scope

Issues, pull requests, Discussions, commit and code review comments in this repository, and any public space where someone takes part on behalf of the project.

## What this project cares about most

- When discussing the skill's content, rely on the official docs, the changelog or live test results, and address the content rather than the person.
- Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean are all welcome. Don't look down on anyone for their language level, experience or choice of AI tool.
- Don't post anyone's access token, app secret, account details or other personal information, including your own. The maintainer will hide or delete anything posted by mistake.
- Harassment, personal attacks, discriminatory language, and sharing someone's information without consent are never acceptable.

## How to report

- **If it needs confidentiality or involves harassment**: email [yao921024@gmail.com](mailto:yao921024@gmail.com). Only the maintainer reads it. Please include links or screenshots of what happened.
- **If it can be public**: mention @Scorpio-meow in the related issue, PR or Discussion, or open an issue describing the problem.
- **You can also hand it to GitHub**: choose **Report content** from the “⋯” menu at the top right of a comment, or click **Block or Report** on the person's profile, and the report goes to GitHub Support. See [GitHub's docs](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/maintaining-your-safety-on-github/reporting-abuse-or-spam) for the full steps.
- **Security issues**: report them privately as described in the [Security Policy](/.github/SECURITY_en.md).

## Enforcement

The maintainer handles reports following the Contributor Covenant 3.0 process, keeps the reporter's identity and the details of the report confidential, and, depending on the case, may remind the people involved, hide or delete content, lock conversations, limit interactions or block accounts.
